title: Faro Cathedral

terrainReference.basis: Original plaza terrain immediately in front of the mapped west portal and stairs. Threshold levels are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap church way 182814167 and bell tower way 433056356 provide the two touching native outlines. Garden way 433056357 distinguishes the neighboring open space.
mapIdentity.scope: The 35-corner church way 182814167 and touching five-corner tower way 433056356 fix the modeled perimeter. The Gothic front and south arches and open bell crown follow the plaza photographs.

note: Two cleared July 2014 exterior views establish the tower, pointed arches, triple bell openings and pale north ranges. Upper roof joins, south and east elevations and exact threshold heights are approximate. The cathedral garden and separate São Miguel Chapel are outside the model.
